answer:
In *Mr. Peabody & Sherman*, Mel Brooks voices **Albert Einstein** (he also voices Sigmund Freud). 

Albert Einstein earned his doctorate (PhD) from the **University of Zurich** in 1905. Before that, he had previously obtained a teaching diploma in mathematics and physics from the **Swiss Federal Polytechnic School** (now known as ETH Zurich) around 1900–1901.
